questions.q: What happens with two vehicles with sysid 1 on the same network?
options: One “jumping” vehicle, commands go to both
The GCS will show both vehicles separately
The second vehicle won't be able to arm at all
The router will reassign one of the sysids itself
questions.explain: Addressing is by sysid: without unique numbers the GCS and commands mix up the vehicles.

questions.q: Why do you set source_system for a pymavlink supervisor?
options: Otherwise it won't receive telemetry
pymavlink doesn't send commands without it
By default it's 255, same as the GCS
mavlink-router requires it
questions.explain: Two participants with sysid 255 confuse failsafe and routing.

options: A command from the ground station
A command to all vehicles
A command to the last vehicle
A packet with no addressee is dropped
questions.explain: Broadcast: for a global stop — yes, as a default — no.

questions.q: Closing speed 20 m/s, delays 1 s, braking 1.5 s. Roughly how far is covered before stopping?
options: 5 m
questions.explain: 20 m/s × 2.5 s ≈ 50 m; plus position errors — the trigger threshold is around 60 m.

questions.q: What's the danger of a shared RTL for several vehicles?
options: It doesn't work in a fleet at all
Draining all vehicles' batteries at once
Converging over home at the same altitude
Resetting the sysid after landing
questions.explain: Separate RTL_ALT_M and rally points, land one at a time.

questions.q: What does FOLL_DIST_MAX do in FOLLOW mode?
options: Beyond it the follower stops following
Sets the follower's offset from the leader
Limits the follower's flight altitude
Sets the speed for catching up with the leader
questions.explain: If the leader is farther than FOLL_DIST_MAX, the follower holds position.

questions.q: Why don't altitude layers solve everything?
options: Altitude is equally accurate for everyone
Layers are prohibited by flight rules
ArduPilot can't hold altitude
Takeoff and landing cross the layers
questions.explain: Changing altitude crosses other vehicles' layers — takeoff and landing are separated in time.

questions.q: Why does a vehicle in a fleet need MAV_GCS_SYSID?
options: To choose the telemetry rate
So another station's heartbeat doesn't keep the link alive
To enable FOLLOW mode
To set the router's number
questions.explain: The loss-of-link failsafe must watch its own GCS, not just any GCS.
